name: Preparation time
description: How long the store takes to prepare an order, when it says.
source:
Component(
  dsl: 1, id: "market/prep-time", name: "Preparation time", kind: Kind.section,
  description: "How long the store takes to prepare an order, when it says.",
  variants: [Variant(id: "default", label: "Default", build:
    If(condition: store.prep_time_minutes, then: Row(gap: Space.xs, crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center, children: [Icon(name: Icons.clock, size: Size.sm, color: Color.primary), Text(child: "Ready in about ${store.prep_time_minutes} minutes", size: FontSize.sm)]))
  )], data: [Data(name: "store", from: Client.store(), fetch: "client", type: Store)],
)
